name: Turn Hermes X research into reviewed image posts with Claude and Buffer

parameters.content:
## Who this is for
Editors who use Hermes Agent to research emerging X topics and want a deliberate path from sourced ideas to an original image post.

### How it works
A protected form calls your research-only Hermes server. Separate post and article quotas, reported engagement thresholds, source dates, citations, and duplicate checks produce an eligible shortlist. A private companion journal stores each candidate. Optional Discord messages include a Create post link button. The linked single-use review page lets you select an idea; the authenticated callback starts Claude drafting and OpenAI image generation. A second review page displays the exact text and image. Only its approval and a future UTC time release the image and create a Buffer reservation. Durable claims prevent repeated button clicks from scheduling twice. Uncertain Buffer responses require manual reconciliation.

### Setup
Download the companion source from Export setup files, install it, configure its private data directory, public HTTPS base and authenticated n8n callback, then select separate credentials for Hermes, Claude, OpenAI, Discord, Buffer and the journal. Set your Buffer X channel, editorial brief, models and research thresholds. Notifications remain optional. Test your credentials and review pages before activating the webhook.

### Requirements and limits
The manual demo is synthetic and makes no external calls. Live use requires your configured Hermes research tools, model services and Buffer-connected X account. You need no personal X API key, although Buffer uses its platform integration. Engagement is Hermes-reported. Review links grant access: use a restricted Discord channel. Approved images remain public until removed from the companion.

parameters.content:
## Setup • Included companion source
Run Export setup files and download companion.zip from the Binary tab. Follow its README. Keep credentials local. Main paths read left to right; lower exits stop or record failures.

## 01 • Research input
Choose a synthetic demo or submit a protected form. Hermes supplies research evidence; no X API key is required.

## 02 • Evidence and candidate review
Validate reported engagement, citations, dates, quotas and duplicates. The synthetic path ends without external calls.

## 03 • Select a topic
Store candidates and private review links. Discord notification is optional. A selected link starts the separate authenticated callback below.

## 04 • Claim the selected action
Validate the callback and claim it once. Verify the configured Buffer channel is connected to X before generating or reserving a post.

## 05 • Generate the exact draft
Claude writes original text; GPT creates its image. Store an immutable draft. The private review page displays the finished text and image before scheduling.

## 06 • Reserve after approval
Only approved drafts reach Buffer. Local lower exits record failures or uncertain responses. Inspect Buffer before any manual reconciliation; never blindly retry.
